notes.en: [[character:alyosha]] is a **[[element:stellar-conduct]] support** who is also capable of providing healing to the active character with his companion, Tugarin, whom is summoned by his [[ability:burst]]. Using his **[[ability:skill]], or the end of a [[ability:na]] string will apply the Hunter's Mark**, which, when **consumed by [[character:alyosha]] using those aformentioned abilities, or if the target with a mark is struck by Tugarin, will grant the team the Hunter's Precision effect**, which boosts their ATK when on the field. If [[character:alyosha]] is also in a [[abilty:polestar-field]], he will also provide a 20% bonus to [[element:stellar-conduct]] DMG. [[character:alyosha]]'s [[ability:burst]] is also capable of taunting enemies.

[[character:alyosha]]'s **[C1]** gives him 15 Energy when a teammate triggers an [[element:electro]]-related reaction, effectively changing his [[ability:burst]] cost from 70 to 55. This has a cooldown of 18 seconds.
